description: Implement a duck-typing solution to detect Prisma null types (DbNull, JsonNull, AnyNull) across bundled environments. Replace all instanceof ObjectEnumValue checks with a function that works when browser and server entry points resolve to separate copies of the runtime utilities.
functional_requirements: Create an isObjectEnumValue() function that checks for the presence of _getName and _getNamespace methods
Replace all instanceof ObjectEnumValue checks in serialization and cloning code with the new duck-typing function
Export isObjectEnumValue from both browser and server runtime entry points
Update null type validation to check by name string rather than singleton identity
Ensure the solution follows the existing isDecimalJsLike pattern used elsewhere in the codebase
Maintain backward compatibility with existing null type usage patterns
